描述_EN: ad 490. at the top is yang hiang, said to have lived during the han dynasty. hanging panel of embroidered red satin in coloured silks (mostly green, blue, black and white, with touches of red, pink and yellow), and silver-gilt thread in satin and stem stitches and laid and couched work. when fourteen years old and in the fields, he saw a tiger about to attack his father, whereupon he threw himself under the talons of the beast and thus enabled his father to escape by the sacrifice of his own life. a scholar and official of the ts'i dynasty c. below is kiang keh. embroidered with two of the stories of filial piety. lined with pink cotton.
描述_ZN: AD 490。 顶部是杨香，据说生活在汉代。 挂板，用彩色丝绸（主要是绿色、蓝色、黑色和白色，也有红色、粉色和黄色的点缀）绣红缎，用银鎏金线绣缎子和茎针，以及铺设和耦合工作。 十四岁时，在田间看到老虎要攻击他的父亲，于是他扑向老虎的爪子，从而使他的父亲以自己的生命为代价逃脱。 是慈禧王朝的学者和官员，约在公元前。 下面是姜克隽。 绣有两个孝道的故事。 用粉红色的棉布做衬里。
